cases.explain: «лживых слухов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “You shall not spread a false report. Don’t join your hand with the wicked to be a malicious witness.

cases.sentence: — Шесть лет засевайте поля и собирайте урожай, 11 а на ___ пусть земля отдыхает под паром.
cases.explain: «седьмой год» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “For six years you shall sow your land, and shall gather in its increase,

cases.sentence: Шесть дней трудитесь, но в ___ не работайте, чтобы ваши вол и осел отдохнули, а раб, рожденный у вас в доме, и поселенец набрались сил.
cases.explain: «седьмой день» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “Six days you shall do your work, and on the seventh day you shall rest, that your ox and your donkey may have rest, and the son of your servant, and the alien may be refreshed.

cases.explain: «других богов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “Be careful to do all things that I have said to you; and don’t invoke the name of other gods or even let them be heard out of your mouth.

cases.explain: «Пресных хлебов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib (for in it you came out of Egypt), and no one shall appear before me empty.

cases.sentence: Пусть никто не приходит поклоняться Мне с ___.
cases.explain: «пустыми руками» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib (for in it you came out of Egypt), and no one shall appear before me empty.

cases.sentence: Справляйте праздник Жатвы, когда собираете ___ посеянного вами в поле.
cases.explain: «первые плоды» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: And the feast of harvest, the first fruits of your labors, which you sow in the field; and the feast of ingathering, at the end of the year, when you gather in your labors out of the field.

cases.sentence: Лучшее из ___ земли приносите в дом Господа, вашего Бога.
cases.explain: «первых плодов» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground into the house of Yahweh your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.

cases.sentence: Сокрушите их и разбейте на куски их ___.
cases.explain: «священные камни» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor follow their practices, but you shall utterly overthrow them and demolish their pillars.

cases.sentence: Я проведу ваши границы от ___ до Филистимского моря , и от пустыни до Евфрата.
cases.explain: «Красного моря» — after the preposition «от», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: I will set your border from the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River; for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you shall drive them out before you.

cases.sentence: Я проведу ваши границы от Красного моря до ___ , и от пустыни до Евфрата.
cases.explain: «Филистимского моря» — after the preposition «до», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: I will set your border from the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River; for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you shall drive them out before you.
